classification.difficultyReason: Complete two native tables, list seven coordinates and construct lines including a fractional intercept; linked familiar representations.

content.prompt: Complete each table of values for the given formula. List the coordinates of the points you get from the table and plot them on a number plane, drawing a line through the points.

spec.description: One blank common-plane response grid, no plotted answers or chosen axes.

answer.worked: Substitute each supplied x-value. The y-values in order are $9,\ 6,\ 3,\ 0,\ -3,\ -6,\ -9$. Plot $(-3,9),\ (-2,6),\ (-1,3),\ (0,0),\ (1,-3),\ (2,-6),\ (3,-9)$ and draw the line $y=-3x$.

spec.description: Exact given linear rules on one common Cartesian plane; editable prose style keys identify every line. Exterior tick-label rails preserve all coordinate values.
